name: Exp_UltraFatl
summary: This EA trades based on the UltraFatl custom indicator, a multi-period smoothed trend-following oscillator. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from below 5 to above 4, and sell positions when it transitions from above 4 to below 5, using the signal bar crossover logic. Positions are managed with fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit levels, with optional position closing on reverse signals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于UltraFatl自定义指标进行交易，该指标是一个多周期平滑的趋势跟踪振荡器。当指标从5以下穿越到4以上时开多仓，从4以上穿越到5以下时开空仓。使用固定止损和止盈管理仓位，并可选择在反转信号时平仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于UltraFatl指标的趋势跟踪系统。UltraFatl指标使用了双重平滑算法：首先对价格进行多步进周期（nStep×nStepsTotal）的初始平滑（支持JJMA、JurX、ParMA、T3、VIDYA、AMA等多种方法），然后再对结果进行二次平滑处理，最终生成一个0-10范围内的振荡值。入场条件：当指标值从低于5的区域穿越到高于4的区域时产生买入信号（Value[1]>4且Value[0]<5且Value[0]非零），当指标值从高于4的区域穿越到低于5的区域时产生卖出信号（Value[1]<5且Value[1]非零且Value[0]>4）。出场条件包括固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点），以及反向信号平仓权限。仓位管理使用存款份额或固定手数（MM参数为负时表示固定手数）。资金管理采用简单的比例仓位或固定手数模式，没有动态调整机制。策略仅在新K线形成时检测信号，避免重复交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following system based on the UltraFatl indicator. The UltraFatl indicator employs a dual smoothing algorithm: first applying multi-step period (nStep×nStepsTotal) initial smoothing to the price using various methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA, etc.), then applying a secondary smoothing to produce an oscillator value in the 0-10 range. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the indicator value crosses from below 5 to above 4 (Value[1]>4 and Value[0]<5 and Value[0] non-zero), while a sell signal is generated when the indicator crosses from above 4 to below 5 (Value[1]<5 and Value[1] non-zero and Value[0]>4). Exit conditions include fixed Stop Loss (1000 points) and Take Profit (2000 points), plus optional reverse signal position closing permissions. Position sizing uses either a deposit share percentage or fixed lot size (negative MM parameter means fixed lot). Money management follows a simple proportional or fixed lot scheme without dynamic adjustment. The strategy only checks signals on new bar formation to avoid duplicate trades.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款份额（正值）或固定手数（负值）
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter controlling lot size

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点容忍度）

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing long positions on reverse signal

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 使用多层级平滑算法减少虚假信号，提高信号质量
具备完整的买卖开平仓权限控制，灵活性高
新K线检测机制避免同一根K线内重复交易
支持多种平滑算法选择，适应不同市场环境
有止损止盈设置，风险可控
pros_en: Multi-layer smoothing algorithm reduces false signals and improves signal quality
Complete buy/sell open/close permission controls provide high flexibility
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate trades within the same bar
Support for multiple smoothing algorithm choices adapts to different market conditions
Stop Loss and Take Profit settings keep risk manageable
cons: 没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
止损1000点和止盈2000点固定值较大，未根据市场波动动态调整
缺少持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同方向仓位时重复开仓
指标值阈值4和5为硬编码，无法通过参数调整
没有回撤控制或最大亏损限制机制
cons_en: No spread filter, which may lead to unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
Fixed SL of 1000 and TP of 2000 points are large and not dynamically adjusted for market volatility
Lacks position check logic, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
Indicator thresholds of 4 and 5 are hardcoded and not adjustable via parameters
No drawdown control or maximum loss limit mechanism
improvements: 将指标阈值4和5改为可配置参数，允许回测优化
添加持仓检查和同方向加仓控制，避免重复开仓
增加点差过滤和动态止损止盈（基于ATR）功能
improvements_en: Make indicator thresholds 4 and 5 configurable parameters to allow backtesting optimization
Add position checking and same-direction position control to avoid duplicate entries
Add spread filter and dynamic SL/TP based on ATR for better volatility adaptation

risk_points: 缺少持仓数量检查，可能在同方向重复开仓导致过度暴露
固定止损止盈未根据市场波动率调整，低波动时止损过大，高波动时止盈不足
MM参数为负值时表示固定手数，缺少最大手数限制保护
risk_points_en: Lacks position count checking, potentially opening duplicate same-direction positions causing overexposure
Fixed SL/TP not adjusted for market volatility — SL too large in low volatility, TP insufficient in high volatility
Negative MM parameter means fixed lot size with no maximum lot size limit protection
